name: decider-check-comment-reason
description: Demonstrates a decider check that grades the comments a change adds, in shadow.

BASE.description: Commit the change is compared against

review.directive: Check the comments your change adds.

criteria.question: Does every comment this change adds record why the code is shaped this way, rather than restating what the code does?
criteria.pass: Each added comment gives a reason, constraint, or rejected alternative that the code can't show.
criteria.fail: At least one added comment restates what the code does, or its reason is only a restatement.
criteria.escape: The change adds no comment, or the comments or the code are missing, so it can't be judged.
